verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents batch-style processing: workflows that move documents from source connectors such as Azure Blob Storage to destinations, plus job APIs to trigger runs, monitor status and inspect failed files. That covers the bulk-ingestion mechanics of the story, but nothing in the pack addresses the scale or predictability guarantees it asks for. Missing for 10: documented rate limits or quotas, throughput or concurrency figures, evidence of handling millions of pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of large-batch performance.
